title: Flesh of the One
description:
The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} this Skill, choose the parent Species your body comes from and, if it has any, one of its subspecies or regional origins. Its {{taille}}, its height and its {{vitesse}} are yours. If it offers more than one {{taille}}, keep one.

For every {{prerequis}}, you count as a character of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin. Also choose one Skill from those of that Species and of the chosen subspecies or regional origin: it is {{memorisee}} without taking up any {{memoire}} and does not have to be bought. You can no longer change it. If that Species does not fix for itself what you inherit from it, as with Undead and Scothans, settle it with the GM.

Every point of {{constitution}}, every Vitality Level and every other source of maximum {{pdv}} grants you 2 fewer than it would grant any other character, to a minimum of 0. A Vitality Level therefore grants you 3 instead of 5, or 4 instead of 6 when a Skill raises it to 6, and a point of {{constitution}} grants you 0 instead of 2. A negative {{constitution}} takes away as much as it would from any other character. Your base of 20 maximum {{pdv}} does not change.

You cannot choose the same Species for {{SANAUT-001}}.
